nodes.label: The Red Queen Gödel Machine: Co-Evolving Agents and Their Evaluators
nodes.author: Alex Iacob et al.

nodes.label: Red Queen Gödel Machine (RQGM)
nodes.rationale: Lets the evaluator itself be a learned, co-evolving agent rather than a permanently fixed benchmark/verifier, addressing tasks with no direct benchmark or where static judges saturate.

nodes.label: Controlled utility evolution (epoch-boundary evaluator replacement + selective erasure)
nodes.rationale: Freezing evaluator within an epoch preserves prior Gödel Machine convergence guarantees; selective erasure discards only utility records tied to a displaced evaluator, keeping re-evaluation cost linear via exponential checkpointing.

hyperedges.label: Co-evolving training signal / evaluator across self-improvement systems
